name: IEWC World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top prize, first awarded to the winner of its own sixteen-man founding tournament.

name: IEWC Americas Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's second-ranked singles title, first awarded on the strength of a screwjob finish.

name: IEWC World Featherweight Championship
epitaph: A weight-limited singles title instituted alongside the promotion's expansion into a full federation; its own tournament was left undecided.

name: IEWC Television Championship
epitaph: Billed as the promotion's most frequently defended title; its own tournament was left undecided.
